explanation.rights: Confirm provider display and redistribution permissions before publishing derived data publicly.
explanation.model: Experimental 16-point Market Health model for both indexes: higher is healthier; 0–5 Risk-Off, 6–10 Neutral, 11–16 Risk-On. Health counts non-bearish scored states (bullish or neutral), not purely bullish votes. Raw bearish counts are retained for archival compatibility. Historical 20-month scores are reconstructed from downloaded market data, not previously recorded historical snapshots. Breadth uses current constituent membership and may suffer survivorship bias. The existing score ≤4/5 historical research still uses the archived 15-point model; future 5-session ETF price returns are descriptive and overlapping. QQQ risk validation adds median, standard deviation, downside-tail and non-overlapping sensitivity statistics plus chronological 10-month halves. RSI(14) and MACD(12,26,9) each add one point; original 50D/200D trend rule is retained; five SMA readings and external Fear & Greed remain informational only.
